comments.author: @saltenya94
comments.text:
Everyone. Purchase a used EV with low mileage. There’s tons of listings for used EVs with low mileage online. DO NOT BUY A NEW ONE!!!! 

There’s less that’s can go wrong than a 5 year old ICE car vs a 5 year old EV. No emissions cost. No oil change. I bought a 2018 Nissan leaf with 40K miles and now it has 107K miles. I drive more miles than most ppl. And it was the best purchase in my life. Drives silky smooth. I mostly drive to work, groceries, and my kid has tons of activities all over the metro area. So we seriously drive it. But we don’t drive 500 miles to relatives every weekend. If you do road trips “frequently” it still would be cheaper than gasoline. But you “Do have to charge” for 45 mins - hour on those long drives. It’s not that bad, most ppl at charging stations watch Netflix / YouTube. Its not that bad at all once a month or week. But I would not recommend  doing that every day. 

NOTE: If you can charge it in your home or stick it from your electric dryer socket across the sidewalk (some HOAs don’t care but others are police states) than it will be amazing. I’ve seen many many EVs with charging cables in townhouse communities. But these are very “low crime / low jerks” communities. YMMV in places where petty crime is more prevalent. But you could try. Most ppl simply “walk over your charging cable” unless your blind it’s easy to walk over them.

comments.author: @dynafire
comments.text: I have to disagree, now is as good a time to buy an EV as any, if you're smart about it.  Because used EVs are becoming available in large numbers due to lease returns, and because of EV depreciation, you can get a better price on a used vehicle now from a range and vehicle tier perspective than buying new when the subsidies were active.  Battery prices go down relentlessly, so "now" is almost always a great time to buy an EV, the balance just shifts between new vs used.  You can buy a new 2026 Chevy Equinox EV with over 300 miles of range for around $33.5k, but you can buy a used 2024 one for about $24k.  "A couple of years ago" was not the best time, maybe Dec 2025 was the best time if you wanted to buy a new one.  But now is the best time if you want the best bang for the buck and include both new and used in your consideration.
